feeds.title: Backpacking Chef
feeds.description: Find recipes for breakfasts, lunches, dinners, snacks, and desserts. I'm Chef Glenn. My posts give tips on how to dehydrate backpacking food, and they aim to inspire you to create your own meals with healthy ingredients and a food dehydrator.

feeds.title: Trail Cooking Blog
feeds.description: Take your time in the wilderness to a new level. Trail Cooking brings recipes, gear, food finds & tips for your outdoor adventures.

feeds.title: Outdoor Herbivore Blog
feeds.description: I'm Kim, and I love to be OUTSIDE and to EAT.I started Outdoor Herbivore in 2010 to address the lack of wholesome backpacking foods on the market. My aim for creating Outdoor Herbivore was simple - to produce one-pot dried meals using organic, whole food ingredients.

feeds.title: Good To-Go Blog
feeds.description: Stay updated on the Good To-Go® blog for stories about camping, backpacking, and adventures with our healthy dehydrated meals, recipes for our handmade camping foods, healthy eating while you're on a thru-hike, & packing emergency kits with our 4-year shelf life meals.

feeds.title: Packit Gourmet Blog
feeds.description: Packit Gourmet is a family-owned and operated online grocery store and line of backpacking meals for campers. We're a family of campers who enjoy good food just as much as we enjoy the outdoors! In our quest to combine our two great loves, we founded Packit Gourmet.

feeds.title: Go Backpacking » Food
feeds.description: Go Backpacking is your online guide to adventure travel. Here you'll find: Stories of adventure travel from around the world, practical, budget-oriented travel advice, original destination and how-to instructional articles, beautiful photography to inspire you between trips, environmentalism, sustainability and how to travel responsibly.

feeds.title: Backpacker's Pantry
feeds.description: Hop inside the pantry and read through our top blogs and learn about tips, tricks, and backing stories straight from the source. Backpacker's Pantry is fueling adventures since 1951.

feeds.title: Gastro Gnome Meals
feeds.description: Check out the latest Gastro Gnome updates, news from the shop, and press features. Gastro Gnome is a backcountry food company that creates super tasty, travel ready meals for people who appreciate great food as much as they enjoy getting outside.

feeds.title: Backpacker » Recipes
feeds.description: From trail tacos to backcountry cocktails, our camp chefs have you covered with easy, yet delicious, trail-ready recipes for your next backpacking trip.

feeds.title: Thruhikers: Renee and Tim » Vegan Backpacking Meals
feeds.description: Find articles on vegan backpacking meals. We are Renee and Tim. We love going on outdoor adventures by foot, bike, canoe, or any other non-motorized transport we can come up with.
